custom_logic_notes: The EA uses CExpert framework from MQL5 Standard Library. Signal class CSignal2EMA_ITF implements ITF (Interactive Time Filter) which restricts trading to specific minutes/hours/days. The 'Limit' parameter (1.2) likely scales ATR to set a minimum threshold for signal strength. Pending orders are placed with an expiration of 4 bars. Expert_EveryTick=false means signal is evaluated once per bar, not on every tick.
python_conversion_notes: The CSignal2EMA_ITF class must be manually decompiled from Signal2EMA-ITF.mqh to replicate the exact crossover logic, ITF time filter implementation, Limit (ATR-based signal threshold), and pending order placement with expiration. The CExpert framework handles order lifecycle (pending→fill→SL/TP/expiration) which must be reimplemented. Pay special attention to: (1) whether SL/TP inputs are in pips or points (likely points based on MQL5 conventions), (2) the ITF bitmask encoding for GoodMinuteOfHour/BadMinutesOfHour (these are bitfields, not simple integers - -1 means all enabled, 0 means all disabled), (3) the ATR-based Limit filter that gates signal entry when ATR is too low relative to EMA spread.
